dev.note: 10 hard items (dense recall 0) used to diagnose v1 and write prompt v2. ar-EG:r16 replaces ar-PS:r16 (identical question text).

validation.note: 20 random items, stratified by module and type, ids disjoint from dev in every language; seed 20261009. Use to compare prompt versions and models. On 2026-10-12 the Palestinian set (ar-PS) was replaced by an Egyptian set (ar-EG): ar-EG:q01 names an Egyptian instead of a Palestinian asker; the other replaced items have identical question text.

tax.note: all 15 tax-module questions once, languages rotated; the localized items t05-t07 use a non-Korean asker (it-IT for the EU spouse rule, ar-SY for Kindergeld, tr-TR for foreign income). ar-EG:t08 and ar-EG:t14 replace the former ar-PS items (identical text). Not yet run with the LLM.
